commitResults.messageTitle: Split command execution into focused helpers
commitResults.messageBody:
Rei.executeCommand mixes parsing, routing, persistence, and response
handling in one long method. This makes it difficult to follow the
command lifecycle and check when changes are saved.

Extract dispatch and task mutation into named helpers, following the
course guideline to avoid long methods. Keep input parsing and error
handling in executeCommand, and preserve response and save ordering.

Add regression coverage for persisted task changes and rejected exit
commands. All 16 JUnit tests, 12 CLI cases, and Checkstyle checks pass
using Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use a stream to select keyword search matches
commitResults.messageBody:
Keyword search uses a mutable found flag and mixes selection with
printing inside a loop. Search results must retain their original task
numbers so users can mark or delete the intended task.

Filter a stream of original indexes and collect the matches before
rendering them. Use the collected list to detect an empty result while
preserving encounter order and case-insensitive matching.

Cover nonconsecutive matches, original ordering, empty lists, and
missing keywords. All 16 JUnit tests, 12 CLI cases, and Checkstyle
checks pass using Java 25.
